decisions.reason: Because this optical spectrum connectivity service survived the firm's early product pruning, was given strong public visibility including the home page, and fits the announced move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, management would be inclined to justify and retain its prior investment unless clear failure became undeniable.

Because the voice number ordering portal also remained after other 2018 launches were removed and builds on the established voice business, management would likely continue it to defend earlier development choices, though its lower visibility and more administrative nature make it somewhat easier to drop than product C.
